walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: Evolution of German Society — a core area of A-Level German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: Evolution of German Society brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: Evolution of German Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

first position

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to Berlin' (by train) in German?
options: Ich gehe nach Berlin.
Ich fahre nach Berlin.
Ich gehe zu Berlin.
Like 'k'.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I use my phone every day' in German?
options: Ich benutze mein Handy jeden Tag.
Ich nutze mein Telefon jeden Tag.
Ich gebrauche mein Phone jeden Tag.
Ich gehe zu Berlin.
Like English 'ch' as in 'church'.
Like 'k'.
Ich gebrauche mein Phone jeden Tag.
A soft palatal fricative (ich-laut), made at the front of the mouth.
